description.value: VPL Marpole Branch is a neighbourhood branch of the Vancouver Public Library system, situated on Granville Street in Vancouver's Marpole community. It is part of one of Canada's busiest and most celebrated public library networks, offering a publicly accessible indoor space to the community. For a touring cyclist, it represents a convenient stop in a residential neighbourhood close to the Fraser River cycling routes.
